carla: Heads-up — Prospect (FinEdge) wants a pilot where they hold the KEK in their HSM, dual-custody, and automated rotation every 2 hours. They also require <20ms egress latency to us-west-2 and an explicit per-call pricing estimate. Can we confirm feasibility and ops impact? :eyes:

marta: Short answer: doable but some caveats. Dual-custody + 2h rotation means we need a fast rewrap path and a cached fallback key to avoid token failures during roll. Need to discuss key-splitting vs attested proxy.

anna: Quick Qs for the prospect: what's expected qps for inference requests that will touch the KEK? and do they want HSM calls on every token or batched (e.g., per session)?

carla: They said peak ~150 reqs/s and mostly short sessions, expect frequent small rewraps (every inference session).

kevin: Latency note: if we proxy to customer HSM over internet, hitting <20ms is unlikely unless we peer or deploy in their VPC. Options: (1) Dedicated Redwood Private in their VPC; (2) colocate edge in same AZ; (3) cache intermediate KEK material for short TTL. Each has tradeoffs for security/SLA.

marta: For rotation: propose staged rollout — rotate KEK, keep previous KEK in cache for X minutes, promote fallback automatically. We'll need an SLA exception for a short reconciliation window during failover. Security team needs to sign off on fallback TTL.

ajay: Pricing: for customer-managed HSM calls we generally charge per-signature/call when we proxy to external KMS, or include in reserved commit if Dedicated. Need to know expected monthly HSM call count. ETA on that number?

carla: I'll ask prospect for monthly projected calls. In the meantime, can ops give a rough per-10k-call surcharge estimate vs hosted?

marta: Rough ballpark: proxying live to customer HSM ~ $0.02 - $0.10 per call depending on throughput and support for attestation + audit logs. Dedicated Reserved contract can amortize that down.

kevin: Network checklist for them: allow outbound TCP 443 to our proxy IPs or configure VGW/VPC peering. Suggest running `traceroute -n us-west-2.proxy.redwood.example` and share results. Also need to whitelist these IP ranges: 3.101.12.0/24, 52.23.45.0/24 (example).

anna: Sending a one-pager with options: `BYO-HSM proxy`, `Private VPC deployment`, `Dedicated (reserved) with on-host HSM`. Will include latency/price tradeoffs and recommended preflight tests.

lisa (legal): Need to know whether customer requires key-escrow or split custody documentation in the security questionnaire. If dual-custody is mandatory, legal needs the exact flow to fill COMPLIANCE_SSA fields.

carla: Prospect said they need dual-custody + key escrow only for emergency recovery, not for routine ops. I'll confirm exact language and share the questionnaire.

marta: One more ops ask: do they require HSM attestation (e.g., CloudHSM with attestation tokens) every rotation? If yes, we add ~100-300ms per rotation when verifying.

carla: I'll check on attestation requirement.

kevin: If they need <20ms, attestation on-path for every rotation will break that. Recommend attestation only at onboarding and periodic intervals, not per rotation.

ajay: Action items: 1) Carla to get monthly call estimate + attestation reqs. 2) Kevin to draft network preflight commands and IP list. 3) Marta to outline fallback TTL and security review notes. 4) Anna to produce cost-one-pager draft. 5) Lisa to prep questionnaire fields with placeholder answers.

carla: Got it. I'll push prospect for numbers this week. Thanks all :thumbsup:
